protocol.objective: Mean over development scenes of the mean band gain (capped at 20 dB) over the 2.5-11.8 s window and each 1.5 s post-onset/offset window, both horizons. Stage A (selector release, fast amplitude release, tracker window) without gate; then stage B (gate) on the stage-A winner. Ties (objective equal to 0.001 dB): longer tracker window, then larger selector release, i.e. the setting closer to v1. Stage B ties prefer no gate.
protocol.freshness: Development random draws in even 10 Hz bands, test in odd 10 Hz bands (interior 2.5-7.5 Hz; harmonic groups 1-9 Hz; drift tones start at 10k+2 to 10k+2.5 and drift paths avoid forbidden frequencies). Test frequencies checked > 2 Hz from all development, earlier held-out and study-01 test frequencies.
protocol.why_new_test_scenes: The release weakness was found on study-01 test scenes, so those are no longer untouched.
protocol.limitations: Synthetic reference prediction only. No acoustic path, playback timing, microphone processing or ear measurement.
